# Abid Hasan Rafi — SEO Expert Portfolio

> Personal website of Abid Hasan Rafi, SEO Expert at MicroDeft and BBA student at Canadian University of Bangladesh.

## About
Abid Hasan Rafi is an SEO Expert working at MicroDeft, a leading software development and digital marketing company in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He is also a BBA student at Canadian University of Bangladesh. He helps businesses rank higher on Google with white-hat, data-driven SEO strategies.

## Services
- SEO Audit & Strategy
- Keyword Research & Mapping
- On-Page SEO
- Technical SEO & Speed
- Link Building & Off-Page SEO
- Local SEO & Content

## Skills
On-Page SEO, Keyword Research, Off-Page SEO & Link Building, Technical SEO & Core Web Vitals, Content Strategy, Google Analytics & Search Console.
